title: Fix Activities tab badge filtering, add challenge persistence, implement Love Wheel physics, and add real-time sync

requirements.summary: Fix badge display logic in Activities tab to properly filter and show only unlocked badges by verifying the filtering logic matches backend unlock conditions from getBadgeMilestones
acceptanceCriteria: Only badges that meet unlock conditions (7-day, 30-day, 100-day streaks) are displayed
Locked badges do not appear in the badges list
Badge unlock status correctly reflects current streak data

file_operations.description: Update badge filtering logic to exclude badges where isUnlocked is false, ensuring only unlocked badges are displayed in the badges list. Add filtering step to remove locked badges from the rendered output based on the isUnlocked property from getBadgeMilestones backend data.

requirements.summary: Connect frontend Love Challenges component to use backend persistence instead of local state for tracking completed challenges
acceptanceCriteria: LoveChallenges component fetches completed challenges from backend
Challenge completion submits to backend endpoint

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for fetching completed challenge IDs (useGetCompletedChallengeIds) using actor.getCompletedChallengeIds() and for marking challenges complete (useMarkChallengeComplete) using actor.markChallengeComplete(challengeId). Both hooks should integrate with the existing actor from useActor.

Replace local state completedChallenges with backend data fetched via useGetCompletedChallengeIds hook. Update completion submission logic to call the useMarkChallengeComplete mutation instead of updating local state. Ensure the component refetches completed challenges after successful submission to reflect persistence across sessions.

requirements.summary: Implement Spin the Love Wheel with smooth deceleration physics using ease-out cubic easing, 3-5 second spin duration, and randomized final stopping angle with slight offset to avoid landing exactly on dividing lines between sections
acceptanceCriteria: Wheel spins with gradual deceleration over 3-5 seconds
Final stopping position uses randomized offset to avoid landing on dividing lines
Animation uses ease-out cubic easing for natural feel
Slight bounce effect occurs when wheel stops

file_operations.description: Replace existing spin animation with physics-based implementation using ease-out cubic easing (CSS cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1)) with 3-5 second duration. Add randomized final stopping angle calculation that includes a +5 to +10 degree offset from section center points to avoid landing on dividing lines. Implement slight bounce effect at spin end using a secondary animation phase with reduced rotation in opposite direction. Update the rotation calculation to use multiple full rotations (3-5 spins) plus the randomized final angle for realistic deceleration.

requirements.summary: Add real-time polling or data refresh mechanism for Activities tab to automatically sync badges, streaks, and challenge data when partner completes rituals without requiring manual page refresh
acceptanceCriteria: Activities tab automatically refreshes data at regular intervals
Streak counter updates when partner completes rituals
Badge unlocks appear without manual refresh
Challenge progress reflects partner activity in real-time

file_operations.description: Implement automatic data refresh using React Query's refetchInterval option for insights data query (useGetInsightsData). Set polling interval to 30 seconds to check for updates from partner activity. Configure refetchInterval on the query to automatically sync badges, streaks, and challenge data without manual refresh. Ensure the polling respects component mount state and pauses when tab is not visible using refetchIntervalInBackground: false.

requirements.summary: Add visual feedback in Activities tab showing progress toward next badge unlock with message like '3 days until next badge!'
acceptanceCriteria: Display shows days remaining until next badge milestone
Message updates dynamically based on current streak
Visual indicator is prominent and easy to understand

file_operations.description: Add progress indicator below the current streak display that calculates days remaining until the next locked badge milestone. Determine the next uncompleted milestone (7, 30, or 100 days) based on milestones data from insights and current streak, then display a message like '{X} days until next badge!' where X is the difference. Include a small progress bar showing percentage toward the next milestone for enhanced visual feedback.
